user.title: Add virtual RF/IR device
user.description: Create a virtual device that represents an appliance controlled through an existing IR/RF remote.

data_description.name: Friendly name for the appliance (e.g. Family Room Fireplace).
data_description.remote: The remote entity (e.g. a Broadlink transmitter) used to send commands to this appliance.

init.title: Manage device
init.description: Codes are your IR/RF code library. Buttons and switches are the controls, composed from codes.

add_code.title: Add code
add_code.description: Store an IR/RF code in the library. This creates no control on its own — add a button or switch to use it.

data_description.name: Name for this code (e.g. Power, Flicker, Brightness Up).
data_description.code: The IR/RF code to transmit. Paste the raw Base64 code; a 'b64:' prefix is added automatically if missing.

add_reference.title: Add remote command
add_reference.description: Reference a command already learned on the remote, by name. Works with any remote whose send_command accepts a command name. Leave the device blank if your remote doesn't group commands under a device.

data_description.name: Name for this code (e.g. Power, Flicker).
data_description.device: Optional. The device the command is grouped under (Broadlink groups commands by device).
data_description.command: The learned command name the remote resolves when sending.

import_codes.title: Import codes from remote
import_codes.description: Select learned commands to add as reference codes. These stay in sync with the remote — re-learning updates them automatically. Already-imported commands are skipped.

manage_code.title: Edit code
manage_code.description: Edit this code, or choose Done to go back.

data_description.name: Name for this code (e.g. Power, Flicker, Brightness Up).
data_description.code: The IR/RF code to transmit. Paste the raw Base64 code; a 'b64:' prefix is added automatically if missing.
data_description.device: The Broadlink device this learned command belongs to.
data_description.command: The learned command name the remote resolves when sending.

add_button.title: Add button
add_button.description: Create a button control that sends a code from the library.

data_description.name: Button name (e.g. Flicker, Brightness Up).
data_description.icon: Optional icon for the button (e.g. mdi:fire).

manage_button.title: Edit button
manage_button.description: Edit this button, or choose Done to go back.

data_description.name: Button name (e.g. Flicker, Brightness Up).
data_description.icon: Optional icon for the button (e.g. mdi:fire).

add_switch.title: Add switch
add_switch.description: Create an on/off switch from codes in the library. For a toggle-only appliance, pick the same code for both on and off.

data_description.name: Switch name (e.g. Power).
data_description.icon: Optional icon for the switch (e.g. mdi:fireplace).
data_description.on_code: Code sent when the switch is turned on.
data_description.off_code: Code sent when the switch is turned off.

manage_switch.title: Edit switch
manage_switch.description: Edit this switch, or choose Done to go back.

data_description.name: Switch name (e.g. Power).
data_description.icon: Optional icon for the switch (e.g. mdi:fireplace).
data_description.on_code: Code sent when the switch is turned on.
data_description.off_code: Code sent when the switch is turned off.

add_light.title: Add light — power
add_light.description: Set the power codes. For a toggle-only appliance, pick the same code for on and off. Next you'll add brightness levels.

data_description.name: Light name (e.g. Counter Lights).
data_description.on_code: Code sent to turn the light on.
data_description.off_code: Code sent to turn the light off.

edit_light_details.title: Edit light — power
edit_light_details.description: Update the power codes. Next you'll manage brightness levels.

data_description.name: Light name (e.g. Counter Lights).
data_description.on_code: Code sent to turn the light on.
data_description.off_code: Code sent to turn the light off.

manage_light.title: Edit light
manage_light.description: Edit the power codes or brightness levels. The slider snaps to the nearest level. Choose Done when finished.

data_description.code_id: The code that sets this brightness level.

add_climate.title: Add climate
add_climate.description: Enable heat, cool, or both. For a toggle-only unit, use the same code for the mode and off. Enter one target temperature per line; the dial snaps to the nearest and steps with up/down.

data_description.name: Climate name (e.g. Great Room Fireplace).
data_description.icon: Optional icon for the climate entity.
data_description.heat_code: Code sent to enter heat mode (required if heat is enabled).
data_description.cool_code: Code sent to enter cool mode (required if cool is enabled).
data_description.off_code: Code sent to turn the unit off (may equal a mode code for toggle units).
data_description.up_code: Code sent to move up one temperature step.
data_description.down_code: Code sent to move down one temperature step.
data_description.temperatures: One selectable target temperature per line. They need not be evenly spaced.
data_description.target_temp: Optional starting target. Defaults to the lowest temperature.
data_description.temp_sensor: Optional sensor for the real current temperature. If unset, the current temperature mirrors the target.

manage_climate.title: Edit climate
manage_climate.description: Edit this climate, or choose Done to go back.

data_description.name: Climate name (e.g. Great Room Fireplace).
data_description.icon: Optional icon for the climate entity.
data_description.heat_code: Code sent to enter heat mode (required if heat is enabled).
data_description.cool_code: Code sent to enter cool mode (required if cool is enabled).
data_description.off_code: Code sent to turn the unit off (may equal a mode code for toggle units).
data_description.up_code: Code sent to move up one temperature step.
data_description.down_code: Code sent to move down one temperature step.
data_description.temperatures: One selectable target temperature per line. They need not be evenly spaced.
data_description.target_temp: Optional starting target. Defaults to the lowest temperature.
data_description.temp_sensor: Optional sensor for the real current temperature. If unset, the current temperature mirrors the target.

error.need_mode: Enable at least one of heat or cool.
error.invalid_temps: Each line must be a number (one temperature per line).
